intended_use: implementation draft of typed source, rights, profile, evaluation, and run-config artifacts for Codex review
input_classification: public source-discovery metadata and public repository files

accepted: typed Pydantic boundary in the dedicated program namespace
one conservative source audit and descriptive profile for each requested person
one common six-case content-controlled B1 slice for each profile
eleven source-specific profile-card coverage configs with standalone adapters disabled
no source bodies, private data, or training approvals
corrections: made evaluation-profile membership exact rather than minimum-length only
cross-validated embedded run references against the eleven config files
added exact provenance-record pointers to every generated machine artifact
narrowed permission_required approved uses so they do not imply source-text permission
removed unverified quantitative and author-position claims
added regression tests for extra evaluation profiles and config-reference drift
codex_review.excluded_use: the draft is not training data, model-quality evidence, legal advice, or a human-confirmed style analysis
